capability_contracts.reason: Both pinned H3 Sol implementations require this module, which Triton 3.3.1 does not provide; Castle Javawock derivatives must remain Sage-only.

declared_blockers.reason: Pinned T8 repository has no declared license or model-card license; no checkpoint bytes are redistributed into the runtime.
The pinned hybrid recipe requires a specific BF16 test4 base absent from the pinned Qrusher repository.

Pinned Triton 3.3.1 lacks triton.tools.tensor_descriptor, so neither pinned Sol kernel is asserted runnable. Saganaki H3 ChunkFeedForward and FusedModulation remain installed, but this experimental Sol lane is isolated from the Sage-only comparison.
This public distribution includes no private runtime receipts, sample outputs, voice references, or prior qualification evidence. Qualify the configured installation before production use.
